questions.q: What does DTW allow that Euclidean distance does not?
options: Matching a point with a nearby point in time
Comparing series of any scale without normalising

questions.q: What is the time cost of plain DTW for lengths n and m?
why: Correct: one table cell per pair.

questions.q: Scenario: two series of lengths 100 and 130 and DTW window w = 10. What happens in a strict implementation?
options: No path exists, unless you use w >= 30
why: The band cannot reach the end cell.

questions.q: Scenario: you must classify 2 million short series per hour. 1-NN DTW takes too long. What do you try?
options: MiniRocket features with a linear classifier
why: Correct: fast features and a linear model.

questions.q: Scenario: you split overlapping windows of the same 10 people randomly into train and test, and the accuracy is 99%. What is wrong?
options: Leakage: the same person appears in both sets
